info.name: Chat System ? Chapter 9 Integration Tests
info.description: Run folders in order against a dev database. C tests access to A-B. Group and Cloudinary are opt-in. Unauthorized access expects 403; current backend may return 400, which is an intentional failing contract check. Extended: groups use D as outsider. RabbitMQ required for /api/chat/send. SSE streams are manual, skip in Runner; HTTP success is not evidence of received events.

item.name: Verify Unauthorized Group Message Not Saved

exec: pm.test("Unauthorized group message not saved",()=>{const messages=pm.response.json();pm.expect(messages.some(m=>m.senderId===pm.collectionVariables.get("idD") && m.messageContent==="Forbidden group message")).to.eql(false);});
if(pm.variables.get("runCloudinary")==="true" && !pm.collectionVariables.get("imageUrl")) throw new Error("Upload must succeed before sending image");
